title: Restrict table/callout nesting: no tables inside tables or callouts, no callouts inside tables
description: Address items 6 and 9 of `novas-tasks.md`: today nothing in the Tiptap schema prevents nesting. `Callout.tsx` (`apps/admin/src/features/editor/nodes/Callout.tsx`) is defined with `content: 'block+'`, which allows any block node — including `table` — inside a callout. Likewise, the default Tiptap `TableCell`/`TableHeader` content schema (`'block+'`, unconfigured in `extensions.ts`) allows a `table` node inside a table cell (nested tables) and allows a `callout` node inside a table cell. Restrict both: `callout` content must exclude `table`, and table cell content must exclude both `table` and `callout`. Update the insertion UI (`BlockHandles.tsx` dropdown, `blockInsert.ts` registry consumers, and the upcoming slash menu from TASK-104) so 'Table' and 'Alerta informativo/de aviso/de dica' options are hidden/disabled when the cursor is inside a table cell or inside a callout, respectively, rather than only relying on the schema to silently reject the insertion.
acceptanceCriteria: Inserting a table while the cursor is inside a callout is not possible (no dropdown option and no schema path succeeds)
Inserting a callout while the cursor is inside a table cell is not possible
Inserting a table while the cursor is inside a table cell (nested table) is not possible
Existing valid nesting (e.g. lists, headings, code blocks inside callouts; text/lists inside table cells) continues to work unaffected
The contextual insertion dropdown reflects these restrictions by omitting/disabling the relevant options rather than failing silently after selection

steps.details: In `Callout.tsx`, change `content: 'block+'` to a content expression that excludes `table` (e.g. a custom group excluding the table node), keeping other block types allowed.
In `extensions.ts`, configure `TableCell`/`TableHeader` content to exclude `table` and `callout` nodes.

In `BlockHandles.tsx` (and `blockInsert.ts` consumers), detect the current node context (`editor.isActive('callout')`, inside a table cell via `editor.isActive('tableCell')`/`'tableHeader'`) and hide/disable 'Tabela' inside callouts/tables and 'Alerta...' inside tables accordingly.

Attempt each forbidden nesting via the insertion UI and confirm it's unavailable; confirm allowed nesting (lists/headings in callouts, text in table cells) still works; run editor test suite if one exists.

technicalNotes: `DosDonts.tsx` (`apps/admin/src/features/editor/nodes/DosDonts.tsx`) has the same unrestricted `content: 'block+'` pattern as `Callout.tsx` — out of scope for this task since it wasn't named in the feedback, but worth a quick look for schema consistency.
TASK-104 (slash command menu) depends on this task so the new suggestion-based insertion UI is built with the same context-awareness from the start, instead of retrofitting it later.
